rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for an abstract quality of elegance in appearance, movement, manners, or style.

example.english: The elegance of this dance feels very natural.
example.traditional: 呢套舞嘅優雅感好自然。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 mou5 ge3 jau1 ngaa5 gam2 hou2 zi6 jin4

rows.note: Choose this when the elegance specifically comes from someone's poise, manners, or graceful conduct.

example.english: They still showed such elegance even after losing the match.
example.traditional: 佢輸咗場波都仲咁有風度。
example.jyutping: keoi5 syu1 zo2 coeng4 bo1 dou1 zung6 gam3 jau5 fung1 dou6

rows.note: Choose this when elegance means a person's distinctive bearing or refined air, especially in appearance and manner.

example.english: In a white shirt, their elegance really comes through.
example.traditional: 佢着件白恤衫，成個人氣質都出晒嚟。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zoek3 gin6 baak6 seot1 saam1 seng4 go3 jan4 hei3 zat1 dou1 ceot1 saai3 lei4

rows.note: Choose this when the elegance is specifically the restrained, tasteful style or overall tone of clothing, design, or presentation.

example.english: The colors in this room are simple, but it has real elegance.
example.traditional: 呢間屋用色簡單，但格調好高。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 uk1 jung6 sik1 gaan2 daan1 daan6 gaak3 diu6 hou2 gou1
